title: flows
tagline: Remittance neobank where money you receive builds a credit score for undercollateralized loans.
description:
Flows is a remittance neobank that turns cross-border money into 
  credit. ~800M people in low- and middle-income countries — 1 in 8 —
  depend on remittances, a nearly $1T market. But where formal credit
  scores don't exist, receiving steady support builds nothing. Flows
  changes that: every remittance grows a FlowScore and a per-sender
  LineScore — an alternative credit layer. That reputation unlocks
  undercollateralized cash advances, with the sender backing the
  receiver. World ID keeps it one human per account.
how_its_made:
Stack: Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind, viem/wagmi,
 Solidity (Foundry) on Base. Money movement on Base mainnet; the lending pool on Base Sepolia.

  Partner tech:
  - Privy — email/SMS embedded wallets. We use session signers + the app
  authorization key to move funds server-side on the user's behalf
  (Grow deposits and auto-executing scheduled payments) — non-custodial,
  no raw keys.
  - World ID 4.0 — proof-of-human, one real person per account (our
  anti-Sybil for credit. )
  - LI.FI — in-app swaps. Privy Earn (Morpho vaults) powers Grow yield;
  Transak for on/off-ramp.
  
  How it fits: every transfer logs an event → a scoring engine derives a
  FlowScore + per-relationship LineScore, which is set undercollateralized
  loan terms in our FlowPool contract.
auto_summary: A Next.js app for remittances, scoring user transaction history, verifying personhood, and managing lending, yield, swaps, and scheduled payments.
